To win a League, you must be in the overall lead after you've raced on seven tracks. Once you've achieved this, a Menu will come up inviting you to choose another League. You cannot have another go at the one you've just successfully completed. Against its name there will now be a little cup.

165609.overview:
Warriors of Releyne is a one or two player fantasy strategy game set in the ancient empire of Keln.

Across the waters of the straits of Kem the warlord Turellin the Great is uniting the forces of Dharak, the land of chaos. Turellin sends his armies of goblins, orcs, trolls and other monstrous creatures to attack the island of Releyne that is defended by only a small band of heroes and their allies.

The player takes command of these forces and uses them to protect Releyne from this invasion. The game comes with three built in scenarios which the player can edit.

The game features include

    over twenty kinds of enemy including elves, goblins, orcs and trolls
    each enemy has over 10 characteristics that can vary from individual to individual
    music and sound effects
    on-line help
    a two player option
    scenario construction options

166439.overview:
Winter Supersports 92 is a sports game with eight events from the Winter Olympiad. The basic goal is to participate in all events in a row (events can be deselected, though) and the player with the most points is the winner. If multiple players participate, two of them are playing at the same time on a split-screen. Then the next batch of two starts.

    Downhill Skiing, Giant Slalom, Pro Ski Challenge are downhill courses in which the player has to circuit obstacles.
    The Bale Jumping and Speed Skating events require the player to alternate pressing left and right while keeping a rhythm.
    Bobsled and Luge are also similar to each other: the athletes are shown from behind and the player has to steer the bob/luge. The bob additionally has a brake.
    Skidoo Racing consists of a top-down course which needs to be completed as fast as possible. Only a part of the course is shown at a time; the screen scrolls.

169443.overview:
Wanderer is set in the future where cats have become very valuable. The hero's cat has been kidnapped by someone who demands 8000 cats as ransom. Additionally, all the planets of the universe are obsessed with an poker-like card game. So the player visits planets, barters cards and plays the card game - and if a planet is satisfied with their own set, they reward the player with cats.

Every time the player visits another planet he has to solve a straight action sequence which utilizes vector graphics for 3D glasses. Here he simply has to fly around in first person and shoot all enemy ships. Other action sequences take place in black holes.

169444.overview: Wanted is a vertically scrolling shooter with a Western theme, similar to Gunsmoke. The player takes the role of a bounty hunter who has to bring four desperadoes to justice. They can be tackled in any order and if all are defeated, a fifth level emerges. The gameplay offers no surprises: shooting masses of enemies until reaching the end of the level. The player can shoot barrels to receive extras, e.g. boots for extra speed or a rifle for a better range. Dynamite destroys every enemy on the screen.

169446.overview:
You start out as a rookie detective whose job is to track down a crop of thieves stealing the world's most precious treasures. After each assignment briefing, you'll be given a deadline to capture the thief that stole the artifact using clues dealing with your knowledge of geography.

The game is an updated version of the original Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego?, featuring enhanced graphics, sound effects, and additional control schemes, such as joystick support for computer platforms.

170886.overview: A bat and ball\Breakout\Arkanoid style game crated by SoftTouch and released by Rainbow Arts in 1988. Many hacked versions are out there with different background images, mostly of racing cars and naked women.

173484.overview:
Having previously recreated the more internationally famed rugby union with World Class Rugby, Audiogenic switched their attention to Rugby League, using the same game engine.

The main differences in the league game is that a team has to give up possession after being tackled six times – which often leads to some bold moves on the 5th tackle, especially as if you retrieve the ball an opposition player, you get a fresh set of six tackles – and that after a tackle, play restarts by flicking the ball back to another player (inexplicably knows as the ‘Play-the-Ball’), while the entire teams (of 13 players, not the 15 in Union) remain on their side of the ball. Instead of line-outs, the ball going out of play at the side results in a scrum, as does a knock-on (fumbling attempts to control a pass or recieve a kick) if those are switched on.

The gameplay is viewed from either a Kick Off-style overhead view or a forced-perspective 3D one, with a scanner on screen to show where your team-mates are (this is more important than in football). Passing is pulled off by pressing fire and directing the pass, whereas holding down fire will kick the ball up ahead. Tackling involves aiming at the player, and diving if necessary. Set-piece kicks involve aiming the direction and angle by pressing fire at the right times to stop a crosshair.

177859.overview:
The sequel to Moebius, Windwalker combines role-playing with side-view beat 'em up gameplay. You are accompanied by Moebius on a quest to master the martial arts.

Hostile persons including thieves, guards and assassins will be encountered; you fight them in real time using moves such as cartwheels and flying kicks. This can be played either as a continuous battle, or with short breaks to catch your composure.

The role-playing elements eschew the Ultima-style plan view in favor of a pseudo-3D system. Deism and Shamanism are just some of the included magic disciplines. Magical vehicles help you get around the 100 landscapes more quickly, although you spend much time on foot. The game takes place in a fully active universe of characters such as villagers and giant beetles, all getting about their business within a day/night cycle and variable weather.

177878.overview:
The Hundred Acre Wood was populated with characters from A.A. Milne's Winnie the Pooh series of short stories.
Each character had lost an item of value to them and wanted the item returned. The player moves through the Hundred Acre Wood and collects the missing items then returns them to their rightful owners. Only one item can be carried at a time, so picking up one item means leaving behind of whatever item is currently being carried. Some screens have interactive sub elements. For example: you could "climb" Pooh's tree and see the limb where he kept his honey pots safely out of the reach of flood waters (a reference to a scene in the Disney animated movie "The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh"and Chapter 9 of A.A. Milne's book Winnie-the-Pooh.). The game has no animation in the mode of a traditional Quest game such as King's Quest. Rather, the Hundred Acre Wood existed as a grid of connected static screens. Players move between the screen using the arrow keys and can only move North, South, East or West. The missing items are randomly assigned at the start of each new game to screens within this grid, although the various characters can always be found on the same screens. When an item is "dropped" on a screen in order to "pick up" another item, the dropped item stays on that screen until the user returns to retrieve it later.
Reuniting a character with their item results in a celebration screen.

178221.overview:
This football simulation focuses on international football, allowing you to play a tournament or single friendly matches. Up to 8 human players can be involved in the tournament. Options include three skill levels, variable match lengths and a choice of sound or music (or both on some versions).

The match is viewed from the side, although it switches to a 3D view when the ball is close to the goal. The ball roughly sticks to the player's foot. Set pieces are controlled by moving an aiming cross-hair.

178278.overview: Become a Wall Street Trader with this managerial-simulation for up to 4 players. At the start of the game stands an test of your knowledge about sharetrading: The more questions you can answer correct, the more money you receive for the start of the game. Buy and sell shares and fonds to maximize your stock. Ingame you receive news from the market on which you must react. The game includes a program to manage your own depots without playing the game itself.

178280.overview:
WCS lets you design and play turn-based strategic battles. You can create scenarios in many different time periods including modern day, ancient times, 1800's, and in the future. You have complete control over all the units, and can customize their firepower, movement points, strength, aggressiveness, etc.

Supports 1 or 2 players. Comes with 8 pre-made scenarios.

178282.overview: A spaceship has crash landed on Planet Arachnia, home of a giant web that catches all kinds of space junk and giant spiders that travel along the web. All of the spaceship passengers have been forced to evacuate onto the web where they find only hungry spiders waiting for their dinner. As Rock Bimhead, your mission is to rescue as many passengers as you can before they are eaten by the spiders. Your spaceship is equipped with radar to find the passengers, fast enough to dodge the spiders, and carries two types of missiles, silver and gold, to blast the spiders. You do not have unlimited fuel and you need to fly over fuel pods to refuel your ship, so watch your fuel gauge! Flying over the fuel pods will also change the types of missiles you are carrying. But the rescue mission is not that simple. When the spider finds a passenger it captures the passenger in a cocoon and when captured the passenger cannot be detected by your radar. When you find stranded or captured passengers (captured passengers will die, eventually), pick them up (only 4 passengers can fit in your spaceship) and take them to the transporter pod where they will be transported to safety and you will return again to the web to rescue the remaining passengers. Once all of the passengers are either rescued or eaten you can advance to another level with another web to search. There are 125 levels in all.

178283.overview:
In the year 2175, Earth has finally come to peace. However, a new threat arises: the TERRONs, the cruelest race in the universe, attacks Earth's colonies in the solar system with giant vacuum cleaners. Some people on Earth managed to hide underground, in a technologically advanced factory. Two of them volunteered to fight the TERRONs with the help of spaceships that were built here.

Wendetta 2175 is a shoot 'em up game for one or two players. The game consists of horizontally scrolling levels and levels where the player controls the ship from behind in a pseudo-3D perspective. Powerups can be collected to upgrade the ship's weapon systems. The ultimate goal is to defeat the boss at the end of each of the seven stages to progress further in the game.

178284.overview:
Whale's Voyage II: Die Übermacht is the sequel to Whale's Voyage. The story takes place twenty years after the crew of the spaceship Whale had won a great battle and became heroes, abolishing a powerful dictatorship. Now all of the money has been spent and the only thing the four heroes can do is to start trading again. The first job should be quite simple: just deliver some nuclear material to a foreign planet. There is also some payment in advance. But unfortunately the crew takes too much time for the delivery and so the easy job becomes a deadly task and they become involved in a conspiracy.

This game is similar to its predecessor, being a role-playing game with trading elements. The character creation allows the player to shape four characters, distributing their primary attributes, among which are combat-related stats as well as categories such as rhetorics and humanity. The player also must select a flaw for each character, ranging from bad temper to epilepsy. These flaws may affect the character's future behavior in certain situations: for example, a clumsy character would sometimes drop an object from his inventory. The choice of education background determines the characters's class. The available classes are Soldier, Medic, Monk, Psionian, Biochemist, Bounty Hunter, Electrician, Rhetorician, Pilot, and Cybertechnician. Human or alien race traits are assigned to the characters randomly.

When orbiting a planet, the player-controlled team can refuel, upgrade the ship with better components, or trade goods. Each planet has preference for a specific kind of wares, and the traders would declare it to the party. Unlike the first game, the player is not confined to one star system, though overall there are only nine planets to travel to in the game. Each planet is presented as a separate first-person maze-like environment. As opposed to the first game, exploration graphics are real 3D, with sprites for characters and objects. The interface has also been modified to include mouse control.

Following the main quest involves talking to NPCs and fulfilling their requests, but the player is free to travel to any planet and explore them from the onset. Through traveling itself is automatic, the Whale may be ambushed by hostile ships on the way, participating in turn-based tactical ship combat. Ground combat, on the other hand, proceeds in real time, with a "general attack" option that makes the party attack at once. Like in other RPGs, the heroes earn experience points by killing enemies or solving quests.

This being the second game in the series, events from the first game are referred to and some characters reappear. For example, a woman which will give the heroes a quest appeared in the first game, where she was still a little girl.

178285.overview: When Two Worlds War is a strategic simulation of interplanetary conflict. Resources, power stations, farms, laboratories, etc are controlled through a state-of-the-art military workstation used to explore and conquer other worlds. The strategy is to increase your own planetary resource and technology levels, while trying to build enough military units of a suitable type to conquer either a human or computer opponent.

178286.overview: Third in the Carmen Sandiego series, you resume your detective role in pursuit of Carmen and her gang in 34 different European nations. Comes with Rand McNally's Concise Atlas of Europe.

178287.overview: As a detective, the player must hunt down Carmen Sandiego's henchmen, who have stolen outrageous items that are important in US history and heritage. Using clues, the player will follow the henchmen from city to city.

178288.overview: Based on the movie. Willow consists of various action sequences which recreate different scenes from the movie including an escape from the dungeons, lost in the ice caves, escaping from guards in the woods, and others. The player can go through all the sequences in order, or read the story in the form of a scrolling manuscript and click on keywords to jump to a particular action sequence.

178289.overview:
Winzer (German for vintner) is a business simulation about the cultivation of wine.

Choose a vineyard in southern Germany, cultivate and harvest grapes, press wine and sell it on the national or international markets. The quality of your wine depends on the type of vines, when the grapes are harvested and how they are fertilized.

You must deal with hiring personnel and buying equipment, registering your wines with the authorities and advertising your products. You can also sabotage your competitors or illegally water down your wines.

You win by reaching a score of 1000 points. Points are awarded by registering wines, creating high quality sparkling wines or placing high in regional or national wine competitions.

178291.overview: Wizards Castle is 2D action game. The player controls a guy, who must go into a wizard's castle. He has 20 lives, and he loses one life with any contact with the enemy - game has several types of enemies, like birds, bugs or slugs. He can kill enemies, by punching them. The hero can collect a various crystal for points. The game has a time limit for each screen. If the time reaches 0, game over.

181171.overview: The Wonders of The Animal Kingdom is an educational game for ages six to twelve that consists of six learning activities. The game intends to train a number of skills including reading comprehension, science knowledge, spelling, memory, logic and pattern recognition.

181600.overview:
Wall Street Wizard is a German stock market simulation. Up to six human players compete against each other or against computer-controller opponents; the game supports local multiplayer via hotseat as well as multiplayer via null-modem cable and modem. One of the special features of Wall Street Wizard is that modem mode allegedly works cross-platform, i.e the Amiga version of the game can connect to either the ST version or the DOS version, and vice versa.

Players get to define a persona by distributing points in four categories (appearance, money, health and luck), thus slightly altering play strategies. The bulk of the game is spent on the trade floor buying and selling shares of fictional companies while the clock ticks (about 12 real-time minutes per round per player!). Wall Street Wizard tries to simulate the buzz and shouted offers of a real trade floor. Once trading had ended, each player gets to invest in strategic activities such as gathering intelligence via newspapers and economic forecasts, investigating or sabotaging other players and improving one's health or appearance.

The game ends once the first player has reached the freely selectable goal, e.g. accumulated a certain amount of wealth.

The game was originally released in late 1988 for Amiga and Atari ST and ported to the PC in 1989. Also available was a separately sold editor that allowed users to alter several of the simulation's parameters as well as edit companies and their interdependencies. This editor came with a '89 scenario (the game's original scenario is set in 1988).

181601.overview: Wet: The Sexy Empire is a strategy game, published by New Generation Software, which was released in Europe in 1998.

181602.overview:
Four arcade-converted racing games feature in this compilation, named after a song by rock group Cream:

Chase HQ.
Hard Drivin'
Power Drift
Turbo Outrun

181603.overview:
Wild Life is basically the same game as the developer's previous Safari Guns with new scenarios (America, Arctic, India and Australia) and interface. In each level, the player is given a list of three animals he needs to photograph. The process is similar to first-person shooters like Operation Wolf: the player controls a crosshair over the left and right scrolling landscape. After an animal appears, the crosshair needs to be quickly moved over them and a click triggers the photograph.

The interface is basically a set of buttons which need to be clicked on to change the active crosshair: hand (needed to pick up additional equipment or medi packs for healing), 50 mm lens, telephoto lens (for small and far off animals) and a rifle (shooting hunters which try to hurt the player). The number of photographs the player can take is limited and needs to be refilled by picking up frequently appearing new rolls.

181604.overview:
Features my favourite cartoons Dick Dastardly and Muttley, among others! 4-player mode requires a null-modem cable with 2 players on each computer. A flying machine shooter game where you can watch your combat from First Person or from outside view. Game designed by Colin Philpott and coded by Paul Glover. Just imagine the characters from Wacky Races all dogfighting with each other in odd flying machines and you've got a pretty good idea of what Wingnuts is all about. 
 
The characters aren't actually from Wacky Races as that would mean they'd have to have been licensed to be used in the game, but with characters called Dicky Dastardly and Smutley, I think you get the picture. The flying machines they get to control are pretty much right out of Wacky Races though, all flappy wings and odd attachments.

Wingnuts is an arena-based dogfighting game. Pick the number of players you want (up to four can play if you link two Amigas with a null-modem cable, with two people sharing an Amiga each), select one of the half-dozen characters, give them a flying machine and then pop along to the armoury.

Now this is an impressive part of the game. There are over 40 weapons to choose from here, although not all are available to all machines all of the time, and some of them are very impressive. The paint missile is a good example. Get an enemy in your sights, wait a couple of seconds for the cursor to change to a death's head to indicate that you've got a lock-on and then fire and forget the missile. If you get a hit then you can laugh at the other player who now has their screen plastered in red paint.

Unfortunately, it's not like some of the other missiles in that it doesn't do permanent damage. The best you can hope for is that the player will become so disorientated that they'll crash into the landscape and die.

181605.overview:
Wipe-Out is a light cycle game with hover boards. The gameplay itself is simple: two players (the second either AI or human) race in a closed off area and both leave behind an energy trail. However crashes into the walls or an energy trail loses the match. Random appearing power ups give advantages if picked up, e.g. going through the opponent's trail. The camera is placed behind the shoulder and the screen is always split.

This is all embedded in leagues on different planets. The ultimate goal is to get better and better until the player is invited to an ultimate championship with a great prize. Between matches, the player can upgrade the hoverboard, e.g. adding brakes or a better engine, or bet on the outcome of AI matches. All planets have a difficulty rating which influences the rewarded fame and money for winning.

181606.overview: World Golf is a Sports game, developed and published by Apex Systems, which was released in 1996. An addictive and truly original golf game for 1 to 4 players in practice and tournament modes. Five authentic courses from around the world. Five Skill levels. Select between 1, 2, 4 or 18 hole rounds. Auto and manual club selection. Ambient sound effects, realistic ball actions and far more!

181607.overview:
World Series Cricket is a Sports game.

Released just before the 1992 World Cup held in Australia and New Zealand. World Cup draw sheets were included with the game so players could organize their own tournaments.

181608.overview: WREX: Waste Recovery Extermination is an Action game, published by Domark, which was released in Europe in 1992

193568.overview: Wiz: Quest for the Magic Lantern is a 2D side-scrolling platform game. Wiz, the last elder wizard, is set on a quest to find the Magic Lantern. Using his trusty book of magic and spell potions, he must traverse many hazardous paths to finally restore light to where dark magic has prevailed.

204057.overview:
Hot on the heels of AlarCity, PixelGlass brings you this high-quality Amiga action puzzle game ' Worthy '.
Worthy is an Amiga game for all 1MB, PAL Amiga machines (including A500, A600, A1200, CD32 e.t.c.) running at 50hz even on Amiga 500! But that's not all, as the game itself is rather massive for an action puzzler, as it also features 40 stunning action-packed levels, mind-bending puzzles, superb 32 colour pixel art, catchy tunes, arcade-style presentation, and multiple endings.
Assume the role of a fearless boy and collect the required number of diamonds in each stage in order to win the girl's heart! Travel from maze to maze, kill the baddies, avoid the traps, collect beers (your necessary "fuel" to keep you going), find the diamonds, prove to her you're WORTHY!! 
Graphics and sound effects by John Tsakiris, coded by Alex Brown (creator of Blocky Skies), and music by Simone BernaccHia.

207287.overview: This all time favorite with children is a certain hit in this totally new style adventure format. The chid can experience being MOLE and make all the decisions. Meet all the characters who live on the river bank and in the woods. Try to outfox Mr. Fox and defeat the Weasels. Enjoy the fun of Ratty, Toad, Badger and your other friends. Hours of engrossing fun, with interactive graphics and text.

208444.overview: The arcade version of ' Wonder Boy ' was designed by Ryuichi Nishizawa. It started its life as a skateboard rock jumping and axe bashing platformer, that later became the great adventure platformer with RPG elements known as ' Wonderboy in Monster Land '. Both of these games have lived on in the hearts of many, and as such, one fan is developing his own Wonderboy game but this time as Amiga port of the Arcade classic which is being developed for the Amigamejam competition by acidbottle.

209048.overview:
WipEout XL is set in the year 2097, around four decades after its predecessor. Instead of the F3600 anti-gravity racing competition, the game features an even faster and more dangerous tournament: the F5000 AG league. The gameplay system is similar to that of the previous game: players race against each other or computer in high-speed futuristic environments, liberally picking up weapons scattered around the stages and using them against the opponents to finish the race in the highest position.

Each vehicle is provided with a shield; once this shield is breached (by weapons or other kinds of damage), the craft explodes. As in the first game, the vehicles move at very high speeds. The game's four difficulty levels are used to crank the speed up and down, with the highest setting corresponding to the highest speed. In addition to the main championship mode, there are also challenge modes, winning in which rewards the player with faster game settings, new tracks, and new vehicles.

211220.overview: Converted from the Atari ST version in 2013 with some very nicely done backgrounds and stunning action. The objective of World Karate Championship is to get the highest possible dan (karate grade, determined by belt colour) and become the world champion - and of course, to get the highest score. Karate fighters compete against each other on side-view screens, the scenery representing real world locations (New York, Egypt, Japan, etc.). In between the fighting stages, there are short action sequences, during which the player can gather bonus points. These include deflecting bouncing balls, breaking wooden planks, and others.

211229.overview: An avoid-em game, you have 5 lanes of traffic coming right at you! You play as a failed driver who has badly enough driven down the wrong way of a motorway against oncoming cars! Collect fuel to keep on going, pick up coins to raise your score, and avoid other cars for as long as possible to reach the best score possible. So good luck and try not to crash!

211369.overview: This PD game is a variant of snake coded in AMOS. It features nice graphics and music. Unlike other snake games I've played, this one allows diagonal turns.

211435.overview: Help Theos the Warrior to rescue his brother from the clutches of the evil knight Gwendor! To accomplish this, you must battle your way through the eight HUGE levels in this game. Each based on a Medieval location. Kill off as many of the Evil Knights minions and monsters as you can, and collect as many gold coins as possible in order to upgrade your weapons in the shop between levels. Throughout the game, there are puzzles that must be solved before you can progress further. This involves setting switches properly and using the platform building magic potion bottles that are available at the right time.

211459.overview:
Here we have Wally World, Created by Richard Langford in 1992 – A quite awesome platformer which has some very nice Title Screen Music (Puppet on a string), along with a Great Starting Animation, and Great Gameplay throughout!

When you start, You see a happy scene with Wally and a Girl dancing, then Lightning appears, and a huge dragon kidnaps the Girl, so Wally jumps in disgust, and thats where the Game Starts

You (as Wally) have to rescue your Girl, your aim is to jump over objects like Robots, Flying Green things, Balls what drop down from the ceiling, and many other enemies who will drain your Energy Bar, once that is depleted, You lose a life, and you only appear to have 2 chances

211697.overview:
The World of Magic is a fantasy point & click adventure game about a young mage named Grendon, in a magical land called Kawamoon. As the game begins we learn that Grendon's home village was attacked by goblins, and the survivors were forced to flee. Now alone and with nowhere to call home, Grendon decides he needs to complete his training in magic. He wanders into a small town in the dead of night, and heads to the local tavern, hoping to find a wizard.

The interface splits the screen into two parts: the top half shows the current scene from a third-person perspective, and underneath is a panel that displays the inventory items you are carrying, as well as eight action buttons ("Look at", "Talk to", "Give", "Pick up", "Use ... with ...", "Open", "Close" and "Operate"). Left-clicking the mouse selects an action button or an inventory item on the bottom panel, or if you left-click in the scene it causes the main character to walk towards the clicked location. Right-clicking is used to perform an action on a scene object or character. There are 10 savegame slots that can be saved to by holding down the shift key and pressing one of the function keys F1-F10, and then later loaded from by pressing the same function key without holding down shift.

211704.overview: Worldwide Hunting is an action game, developed by Golden Gate Crew and published by Golem, which was released in Europe in 1992. An urgent message comes from your favorite game preserve. The surplus of ducks and rabbits in the area is threatening to mean starvation and disease if we cannot act fast and reduce their numbers. Test your skills and patience, choose the proper firearm and get out in the bullrushes! Originally released for the Golem Light Gun Package, in 2019 Scoopex released a version with mouse support.

211705.overview: An Italian language sailing competition game created by Gianluca Sclano and Maurizio Giordano of Linda Soft using AMOS and released in 1992.

211721.overview: This is a brain-taxing and fun little platform puzzler from Andrew Campbell of Black Dragon Design with music by Mike Richmond. Guide the little lupin to the exit on each level by moving blocks around, at least the ones that move the way you want them to! They often won't stop until something stops them. Three difficulties and a password system for easier replays.

211782.overview:
WarWizard is a fantasy role-playing game similar in concept and style to many other computer games that have been around for over ten years.  Yet while it is not intended to be revolutionary in concept and approach, it is evolutionary and contains many details and features not found in other games of the same genre.  The authors have attempted to create the most realistic and involved role-playing game given their resources, but have also tried to exclude tedious and annoying features found elsewhere.  This objective is obviously subjective, however the authors, who have played and enjoyed most role-playing games on the market, feel they have met the majority of their goals in creating WarWizard.  

Along with intricate features and realism, WarWizard also possesses some of the finest artwork found in role-playing games.  In addition, the interface was carefully planned to make some of more tedious tasks execute more quickly.  The authors feel they offer the most intuitive mouse-based interface available in a role-playing game to date.

Because of these and other reasons, the experienced game player may wish to skip the detailed directions that follow and jump right into the game.  We suggest reading the 'installation' and 'starting a new game' sections to ensure you begin properly, but beyond that you many refer to the manual merely as a reference tool.  The beginner, on the other hand, is encouraged to read through the entire document so that he may enjoy WarWizard to the fullest extent.

Essentially, the objective of WarWizard is to search the world in order to find clues as to the locations of the Artifacts your predecessor used to defeat the first High King of Terwan.  Upon retrieving all nine artifacts, you are to locate the current High King in Aladain and defeat him in battle.  During the quest you may acquire treasure, magical items, and up to three other companions with whom to aid you.  Note that these companions may and should vary and that you most likely will not keep the same ones throughout the game.  The characters and their classes will vary as the game proceeds, and it is up to the player to determine how he will utilize their various and unique talents on different parts of his quest.

211873.overview: A Tangram style game and fiendish puzzler from Thomas Behrends and Thorsten Maack and released by Markt & Technik in 1991. It was released in a compilation with Quatromino / Trio / Wipe Off was also released on Power-Disc #6.

211891.overview: A short, 4 level platformer released on the compilation Mutantology and the precursor to Wiz 2. A AMOS programmed Mario style platformer. This game won "Game of the Month" in Amiga Format Reader's Games in 1997.

211895.overview: A bat and ball Breakout\Arkanoid style game created by Harald Müller (Mueller) and published n 1993. It is the precursor to Power Walls.

211977.overview: A vertically scrolling shooter from NC. Gamez with excellent graphics.  The levels even have a varied look to them. Precursor to Groundwars: Waponez 2

211978.overview: A vertically scrolling shooter created by Marcus Johansson in 1997.

211979.overview: Some would call this politically incorrect, others view this game as an early video game that embraced those differently abled. In this one player game, you and your 3 competitors attempt to be the last one upright in the wheelchair gladiators arena. Initially intended to be a four player game, it does not appear that functions correctly, take out your opponents with weapons,, punches and skillful wheeling.

211980.overview: A scrolling screen platformer for 1 or 2 players, a sequel to WiZiO, created by Steve Eaborn, Daniel Johansson of Mr. E Software. A Mario inspired game written using Amos Professional.

211981.overview: A Worm\Snake game coded in AMOS by Mikkel Fredborg and released in 1997. This one has a very large playing field and areas you must switch between by opening gates.

212048.overview: Published in Amiga Power no. 15, July 1992, this Jet Set Willy style, single-player platformer was created by Paul Robershaww aka Zoot for Mental Image Software Design.

212049.overview: Written in AMOS Professional. Coding by Richard Williams. Graphics & music by Steven Tate. Game features save game support and a quit back to WB option (by pressing CTRL-C). Based unofficially on 1984 Matthew Smith/Software Projects Spectrum release JET SET WILLY, but updated for the Amiga. . Each room has its own hazards, such as spikes, guardians (ranging from demonic heads to giant penknives), and ropes which can be climbed and grasped in mid-air. Touching a monster or a stationary hazard, or falling a great distance, causes instant loss of a life and places Willy back at the room entrance. The route through the house must be navigated carefully, due to the multiple entrances to some rooms - this is perhaps the first action game where mapping is an advantage.

212050.overview: Can you win the world cup? The ultimate world cup simulation! Play the World Cup, full match arcade section. Every side human or computer controlled. All the thrills of world soccer competition. Extra time and penalty shoot-outs. All results shown in detail. The most versatile & comprehensive game of it's kind. Up to 24 players can take part in a single competition. 100 international teams, including all the current teams competing in the 1994 World Cup. Full editing facility. 2200 international players. Varying weather conditions and pitch type.

212051.overview: Space Invaders on Steroids. A single screen shooter where you have more firepower, but way more enemies to deal with, including mini bosses and big bosses.

212115.overview: A Defender style horizontally scrolling shooter with some really nice music and gameplay. This game has power ups and retains the baddies Heads-Up-Display and your allies being captured and taken to the top of the screen, so make sure to save humanity!

212116.overview: World Cup Cricket Masters is a cricket game created by Eddie Hayes and published by ESP Software in 1994. Edit your team, play single matches, view current scores and draw for the world cup. Choose from a world of teams, check the wicket conditions and the bowling factors to determine your best course of play.  All the quality and game play that you would normally expect from an ESP Software game.

212135.overview: Wålly the Wörrm is an Amiga worm/snake arcade game released in 1996.

212136.overview: WellTrix is a clone of WellTris (which was an official sequel to Tetris but with pseudo 3D graphics) for the Commodore Amiga. It was developed by Valan and published in 1990 in an issue of Amiga Power magazine.

212213.overview: An absolutely excellent multi scrolling space-shooter created by Tero Lehtonen of Fist Unlimited. All the arcade feel without leaving your house as you blast the enemy base to ribbons.

212215.overview: A first-person action adventure\horror game from Artworx Design released as Freeware in 1991.

212237.overview: Someone, K Suddick in fact, made an unofficial sequel of the C64 game for the Amiga, it was coded for the Blitz Basic Coding Competition in Amiga Format.

212239.overview: A horror themed Beat'em Up game by B Bell, the sequel to the original Wrath of Gwendor and precursor to the Wrath Of Gwendor: Special Edition '97.

212240.overview:
Released on Amiga Format issue 99, July 1997, coverdisk 99B. Wormtris is a Tetris clone from JBSoft Software Development released in 1997.

The game only features the one mode so it's simply a high score based game.  The difference in this one is worms, sheep, UFO's and other things fall and can aid or hinder you as you play.

212241.overview: A single player action game created by Mad Virgin and released in 1995.  Move blocks around the playing field to push the button or trip the switch that will allow you to move to the next level. The screen will sometimes contain helper items like Teleport, flash, pull backs, extra strength potions or extra time. All the work must be done quickly as time is running out!

212244.overview: Often found published in a compilation with Diamond Fever, this 2D plotting, single screen puzzler for one or two players was created by André Willms of Cyberstyle and published in Amiga Fun in 1989.

212245.overview: This is the first game by programmers Dean Furzer and Michael Matthews. Wizard's World is a 2D platform game, developed and published by Stratagem, which was released in Australia in 1991. Fun if sometimes frustrating platformer in which you play a blue elf picking up fruit and zapping the baddies to make your way to the exit of the level.

212246.overview:
A PipeDream\PipeMania clone created by Omega Demos and released in 1992. Can you help Willie control his waterworks To do so you must prevent the water from escaping by placing differently shaped pipes on the playing area. The number of pipes needed to hold the water is shown in the pipe counter and when this reaches zero you have completed the level. You can carry on laying pipes for as long as you like to get a bigger score.  
 
Hazards appear on later levels to hamper your progress which can range from Broken Squares to one-way pipes and End Pipes of two types. One that is optional and one that is required to pass the level.

212247.overview: A racing game where you set the difficulty, number of waverunners, laps and the level of gravity. Stay on the track and hit the speed boosts to go as quickly as possible around the track to hit the finish line fastest. Using your guns will slow you and eventually overheat your craft, so use weapons sparingly.

212522.overview: The game is composed of a board with two players (no AI is included), this makes game development even easier. The mission of the game is to defeat the other by getting the most winning point. The amounts of rounds are determined by the setting configured in the Option menu in the title screen. It is similar to the tic tac toe type game in one exception, instead of having to form 3 lines and it is X against O, you must form 5 lines and it blue player verses red player.

212523.overview: Pen in and trap the Woogles, but don't let them touch you. Push the blocks together and get them in one they can't squeeze out of. Watch the diagonals!

212645.overview: A one or two player Pac-Man clone written by Chris Richards in Amos with 6 ghosts and some unique challenges like invisible dots to collect. Full version came with a level designer.

212647.overview: Wooden Ball by Patrik Holmstrom of Sweden; a sort of frantic Speedball clone. The quality of this game is such that it's quite hard to think how it could have been done in AMOS.

212649.overview:
3-player puzzle/platform action. Does anyone remember a game called 'The Teller' ? No? Well, it was something like this:

    There were 3 strange wizards, they were each shown a 5x5 pattern in their own 'base'. This pattern then disappears and its a mad rush to re-make their pattern with blocks flying around the screen. Once a player completes the pattern the correct blocks the players got were totaled up and added to there score.

212655.overview: World of Soccer is a Sports game, developed and published by Challenge Software, which was released in Europe in 1992, it was released in the Championship Challenge compilation. Enter the world of International League & Cup football with this superb strategy game. Your career in World of Soccer may take you to many different clubs all over the world in your challenge to reach the top n International Club Football. 5 Skill levels, 15 of the world's premier leagues. Featuring 240 clubs and over 2600 players.

212656.overview: The evil wizard challenges you to enter his domain..and survive!!!  Created in AMOS by Andy Paul. The evil wizard has taken the sweet princess and hidden her in the deepest level of his labyrinthine lair. You a modern day knight in shining armour, must drive your supercharged car through the levels collecting  4 transporter tablets on each level. When you have the 4 then you can land on the transporter to take you to the next level. Shoot the censors installed in the hallways, they block your way and also let the wizard know where you are.

212659.overview: A bi-plane shooter created by P. Valli and released to the public domain.

212660.overview: Willy Worm and His Bunny Assault. A little Amiga game by the Animators scene group with adult themed play and featuring a one or two player game. The longer you can keep your *ahem* worm going the more of the playmates you will see.

212661.overview: Wild West is a first-person shooter. The game takes place in the Wild West. The player may select one of two available cowboys - first guided by the keyboard in exchange for higher energy level, second is directed with a mouse, with very limited energy level. The gameplay is arranged on a single board. The player's task is to track down and kill the enemies before they fire a bullet. The game is divided into four scenery chapters (sun plain, jail, dead city, valley of the shadow), each made of four stages and one bonus mini stage, involving rabbits killing. The last stage is played as a typical wild west style duel with a Robson as a final opponent.

212663.overview: An Artillery Duel\Scorched Earth clone by JPV and released in 1992.

212664.overview: Just when you thought real-time strategy war-games were starting to get bloody boring, out comes WarGrounds... (and you can multi-task in rt!). Game was created by Martin Edwards aka edwardsc and released in 1999. The game, creted with 2 years of work in Blitz BASIC was intended to be a clone of Dune 2 on steroids.

212666.overview: A four player board game somewhat resembling clue where you find out Who Did What and where they did it!

212859.overview:
Well Defence is a 1-player arcade game.

The player is perched atop the ramparts of a medieval castle as enemy invaders attempt to scale the walls. The player can move horizontally, and boulders can be obtained from the far edges of the screen. The player's goal is to toss boulders down upon the enemy hordes, thus knocking them to the bottom of the castle. The player advances to a more difficult level every 200 points, and the speed which enemies ascend increases. When an enemy makes it to the top of the wall, the player is tossed to the ground, and the game is over. Goal is to maximize score.

213594.overview: A very advanced and complex version of Worm\Tron created by James Jacobs of Amigan Software and released starting in 1994, with additional versions released to the present time. The game has support for up to 4 simultaneous players. There are 36 types of creatures, 36 different game objects, 12 bonus levels and a built-in level editor to allow you to make your own levels and level sets. Two keyboard players, four joystick players and\or four CD32 game pad players are supported. It is system friendly, style complaint and screen mode sensitive. It also supports an array of different languages.

213595.overview: Game appeared on "Amiga Action" (No. 63) November 1994 Cover Disk (Disk 1). It is also known as Wire Chaos. Later version v1.81 was released to public domain by David J. Cruikshank in December 2010. It is a top down light cycles game with increasing complexity, reaction and navigation tasks.

214465.overview:
The Word Master is an Asian-themed educational game for multiple systems.

Contains several educational vocabulary games with 6 levels of difficulty:
• Master's Maze: Navigate a maze by filling the correct vocabulary into sentences
• Master's Review: Flashcards showing vocabulary and their meaning
• Placement Test: Test the player's vocabulary skill level
• Vocabulary Challenge: Multiple choice vocabulary quiz

214760.overview: A bizarre Pac-Man clone where you play as the titular character on a unicycle, running away from ghosts. Originally released from Unicorn Valley BBS and later on The Assassins Games Vol 154 with Bob's Garden and Kaboom. Also found on Epic Public Domain Software disk C899.

214761.overview: Created by Dug Barthram, this PD action game has you hopping around the garden, munching on delicious flowers and plants and avoiding the farmer. It was released as part of the Present Megapac 5.

214762.overview: A single player puzzle game from Peter Handel, released as freeware in 1992.

214763.overview:
WAR! Version 1.0 - By Andrew Harrison, a 2-4 player tank combat game. Simply blast the hell out of your mates tanks with the weapons available to
you. There are two power-ups available in the game. The shield icon restores a random amount of your shields energy while the power icon increases your tanks selected weapon ammo supply. The four green bars next to your tanks window show how much ammo you have.

214764.overview: A public domain dueling byplane dogfight shooter created by Andreas Osswald. Pick your plane and take the others down.

214765.overview: A strategy wargame created by Robert Kaffka and released as freeware in 1996.

214766.overview: As painful as this game's name sounds, it is just another puzzler from the puzzle meister, Harald Müller (Mueller). This one published by multiple companies in 1995.

214767.overview: A solitaire game aka Windmill or Propeller set to the Amiga by Harald Müller (Mueller) and first released in 1995 and later republished in Gamers' Delight 2. A solitaire card game played with two decks of playing cards; it is a relatively mechanical game that isn't won that frequently. It is so called because of its distinctive initial layout, which resembles a windmill's sails.  First, an ace is placed at the center. Then eight cards are placed around in such a way that the layout looks like a cross. The ace forms the primary foundation and the eight cards form the reserve. The gaps at the corner of the "sails" are reserved for kings and form the secondary foundations. The suits of the kings to be placed on the secondary foundations are disregarded. The object of the game is to build the primary foundation up to king with 52 cards in it and the secondary foundations down to ace with 13 cards each in them. All foundations are built regardless of suit.

214770.overview: World Hockey League Manager is a German language sports hockey game, developed and published by Sayonara, which was released in Europe in 1993.

214771.overview: Not to be confused with the Worms artillery duel franchise, this snake\worm game was released in 1994 by Future. Guide your worm around various gardens eating flowers and avoiding rocks. Each flower eaten will cause your worm to grow by one segment. Complete gardens by eating all flowers. Collect Bonus letters for extra lives.

214856.overview: Something very much in the style of Tracksuit Manager but with real player names in this 1994 football\soccer management game by Summit Software.

214857.overview: Walls - The 97 Edition is an updated version of Walls, the bat and ball, Arkanoid variant created by Virtual Dimension as giftware\freeware and created using AMOS. It had several revisions and updates, ending in version 1.8 in 1998.

214858.overview: Shareware puzzler written in AMOS. Electrosoft is the developer/publisher the game was coded by Philip G. Harle in 1992. Despite being shareware, the game is uncrippled. Additionally, instructions are contained in-game. Featured also on The One 48, disk B.

214860.overview:
WolfPac is a 3D Pacman for Amiga computers, it allows you to live the adventures of Pacman from its own perspective. It features fast, full textured 3D graphics (256 colors, any displaymode you want), lots of sounds and levels and full multitasking support. WolfPac is shareware, but the current unregistered version is not limited in any way.

WolfPac should run on any Amiga with OS 3.0 (even the Draco, except for sounds) or above, a 68020 or above, 2 MB free RAM (approximately 400 KB free Chipmemory) and a displaymode with at least 320*200 Pixels in 256 colors. However a faster cpu (=68040 25 Mhz, PPC supported) and a fast graphic board are recommended (it is optimized for the usage with graphic boards).

Since WolfPac 1.4 there is a special version for Amigas equiped with a PPC board from Phase 5 (or a 100% compatible one). The PowerPC version needs at least ppc.library 45.16 or higher.

215027.overview: In this 1996 update to the game from B. Bell you must Help Theos the Warrior to rescue his brother from the clutches of the evil knight Gwendor! To accomplish this, you must battle your way through the eight HUGE levels in this game. Each based on a Medieval location. Kill off as many of the Evil Knights minions and monsters as you can, and collect as many gold coins as possible in order to upgrade your weapons in the shop between levels. Throughout the game, there are puzzles that must be solved before you can progress further. This involves setting switches properly and using the platform building magic potion bottles that are available at the right time. This version was released as an Amiga Format cover disk.

215045.overview: Written in GfA Basic. Game design & coding by Guido Appenzeller. Graphics & level design by Sören & Guido Appenzeller. Music by Christoph Gund; sound FX by Guido Appenzeller. English translation by Hawkeye/The Amigo's. Published in  The One Amiga no. 47, Aug 1992. According to the instructions on disk, WIZZY'S QUEST includes a hidden level editor that could only be accessed by players if they made a donation to main coder Guido Appenzeller via snail-mail. The game is a Solomon's Key type platformer, or a Spherical clone some might say. The aim of the game is to reach the Dragon. All 50 levels must be completed  to do this. In every Level there is Wizzy, his Master and one door It is your task to bring the master to the door without running into  one of the many, many monsters that you will meet.  To achieve this you can make stone blocks appear and also disappear, you may also use some of the many objects available.

215170.overview: An unofficial port of the Spectrum original by Microsphere, created using AMOS over the course of 11 months. Your aim is to get from the left to the right of each cave where the Ghostrider waits, whom you must outrace back to the start. Along the way, you have to manage your fuel and avoid hitting any obstacles. For a game in which you ride a motorcycle, it plays out surprisingly slowly. It's more about memorizing the caves and timing your maneuvers well than about racing as fast as possible. Released on the F1 Licenceware CD-Rom Volume One F1-001 To F1-100 compilation.

215238.overview: Originally released at the Ami Expo '90, this updated Centipede style shooter game by Will Baecker, Lutz Osterkorn and Achim Moller of Amiga Dos, created using the Pegasus Development System.

215327.overview:
This sequel to The World of Magic was released as licenseware in 1999. The World of Magic II: Ghelae and the Death-Sword is a fantasy point & click adventure game, set many years after the events of the first game. Grendon, the young hero of the original World of Magic, is now too old to go on his own adventures. Instead you take on the role of Ghelae, Grendon's son. Ghelae has grown up in comfort in his father's fortified home, kept safely away from the dangers and violence of life in Kawamoon -- but the time is fast approaching when the he will have no choice but to go out into the world and prove himself a hero.

The interface splits the screen into two parts: the top half shows the current scene from a third-person perspective, and underneath is a panel that displays the inventory items you are carrying, as well as ten action buttons ("Look at", "Talk to", "Give", "Pick up", "Use ... with ...", "Open", "Close", "Push", "Pull", and "Operate"). Left-clicking the mouse selects an action button or an inventory item on the bottom panel, or if you left-click in the scene it causes the main character to walk towards the clicked location. Right-clicking is used to perform an action on a scene object or character. There are 10 savegame slots that can be saved to by holding down the shift key and pressing one of the function keys F1-F10, and then later loaded from by pressing the same function key without holding down shift.

215393.overview: A Sokoban style puzzle game for one player, released: 1999-04 on Mekka Symposium 1999, ranked 4 in the 32k Game competition. AGA Chipset required.

215443.overview: A top down view Rugby game in which you can play both World Cup and 5 Nations tournaments.

215444.overview: This rugby sport game by Denton Designs was released in 1995. It follows the previous releases World Class Rugby and World Class Rugby: Five Nations Edition1

215499.overview: A platform game from Chris Black Leathley with music by Rod Utting and released in 1993, but the game shows 1989. Chris also reveals on his web site that the title screen was a blatant copy of the Monty on the Run! title screen, and that this was the early demo which he sent to Gremlin Graphics.

215524.overview:
Willy the Kid is an illustrated text-adventure by German company Kingsoft. It was also released for Atari ST and came out in German language only . You play an unnamed courier who works for "Fells Wargo" and is tasked to bring money to pay out wages to "Crasy Town". Shortly before reaching Crasy Town, you get knocked out and robbed. Now you need to find a way to get the money back.
The game is a normal text-based adventure with still pics. There several icons on screen for convenience. You can click on them to fill in commands which are often needed, these are give, take, look, ask about and the four basic directions.

217106.overview:
The original, the fantastic platformer ' Wonder Boy ' was designed by Ryuichi Nishizawa. It started its life as a skateboard rock jumping and axe bashing platformer, that later became the adventure platformer with RPG elements ' Wonderboy in Monster Land ' that many of us know and love to this day. I myself mainly played it on the Amiga and although it was addictive as hell it suffered from being a straight Atari ST port with poor colors and long loading times. Thankfully our good friend Earok was on the case, as now he's released 'Wonderboy in Monster Land SE'; A special edition of that port.  
 
As you journey through Monster Land through twelve levels, you will need to find and defeat the dragon MEKA. You will earn gold by defeating enemies which you can spend on buying weapons, armor, shoes, magic and other useful items

217259.overview: This is the Scottish Amiga Users Group entry into the 2022 Amiga Blitz Basic Game Jam, and should probably be considered a work in progress. Further updates will be released here as and when they happen.

217567.overview: Wizmo is a Platform game, developed by CrossTechnics and published by Kingsoft, which was released in 1988.

217569.overview: Word Plex is a Wheel of Furtune like game, developed and published by PAR, which was released in 1988.

218086.overview:
We must put blocks on the table. If horizontal or vertical line is complete, we have more points. If we don't have empty place for blocks, we must click on "GIVE UP", because I don't write an algoritm to searching empty places for blocks.

Based on the popular mobile/tablet game of the same name.

218087.overview: Make all the pieces fit in the space you are provided without a single missing space. It can be done! A puzzle game from Markus Wienberg released in 2022.

218956.overview:
Wiraż is a racing game for four players (human or computer), similar to Supercars II. The objective of the game is to win the race and fit within the time limit. Collisions with the other drivers, side of the road or various obstacles cause significant deceleration of the vehicle.

The game features cup mode and arcade mode. Cup mode allows to select one of the twelve available tracks and the number of laps (one to nine). The winner of a single race wins the cup. Arcade mode features four laps races with no possibility to choose the track. Only the winner passes to the next stage and defeat withdraw back to the first track. This means that from the second phase the player races only with the computer drivers.

218957.overview:
W Potrzasku is a science fiction game.The protagonist of the game awakens in a cocoon together with another man. After a brief conversation the humanoid alien enters the room and takes a companion to carry on the experiments. On the floor lies a steel plate, the output from the room is blocked by the laser barrier.

The objective of the game is to escape from the alien base. The underground base is full of traps, closed doors, hostile mechanised units and useful items, that should be used in appropriate places. Entering all of the doors requires using a proper access card. Encountered enemies may be killed with a pistol or appropriate use of electric fields. The energy level may be supplemented by drinking fresh water, what requires finding a bottle and fresh water supply.
The game screen is divided into labyrinth view and action panel. The game is presented in first person perspective, with rendered animated graphics. The control is done with the mouse by using the direction arrows or one of the action icons (use, describe, inventory).

418385.overview: Load up your wheelbarrow with the sixteen pieces of a puzzle scattered on the interconnected floors of a 3D maze. Whenever you switch floors, the game cuts to a 2D view of the wheelbarrow hero in the elevator. This is less a game and more of an experiment in 3D graphics.

418419.overview: A shareware effort from Cool Cucumbers and just what this platform needed, a Worm\Snake game coded in AMOS. Finally!

418563.overview: Wisielec is a medieval themed word-guessing game based on Hangman. To save the life the player has to guess the password. Before each round the player gets to know the category. The player may choose each of the letters (consonants and vowels), wrong answer means the loss of one point and ends up drawing a part of a hanged man. Good answer gives one point. Error-free guess gives bonus points - depending on the number of letters occurring in the password. The game features ten difficulty levels .

418648.overview:
An Open Source Conversion from the DOS version of the game. Several versions exist some play considerably better than others depending on your hardware. Like the original, Wolfenstein 3D is an episodic first-person shooter and a follow-up to the top-down infiltration game Castle Wolfenstein. The game puts the player in the boots of B.J. Blazkowicz, an allied spy. There are six episodes: the first distributed completely as shareware; the second and the third available after registration; and the three final missions (which happen before the events of the first episode) available in the Nocturnal Missions pack.

In the first episode (Escape from Wolfenstein), B.J. is captured, but overpowers a guard with the help of a concealed knife and manages to get out of his cell. Throughout the next nine levels, the player guides B.J. searching for an escape from Wolfenstein, guarded by Hans Grosse. After returning to Allied territory, B.J. is given the instructions to Operation: Eisenfaust, where he has to stop Dr. Schabbs and his army of mutant prototypes before they are released into the battlefields. The final mission (Die, Führer, Die!) has a simple goal: infiltrate the bunker under the Reichstag, and terminate Hitler (in a robotic suit) himself.

The Nocturnal Missions are focused on the Nazi plans for chemical warfare, and start with Dark Secret, where B.J. hunts for lead researcher Dr. Otto Giftmacher. It's followed by Trail of the Madman, where the goal is capturing the war plans guarded by Gretel Grosse, and the final episode Confrontation, where B.J. meets General Fettgesicht, the planner for the chemical assault.

Each episode has nine levels (eight regular and a final boss level), plus a secret level activated by a hidden switch somewhere in the eight first levels. Regular levels often feature a maze-like appearance or large areas with many enemies (the number of them on each area depends on the difficulty level), where the player must reach the exit elevator. To do so, he must kill the enemies (while it's possible to move behind the guards' backs and even there's a slight bonus in attacking them from behind, most enemies have to be dealt with by firepower), and depending on the level, activate "push walls" and/or get silver and golden keys to open certain doors.

Many objects can be found in a level, from medikits, chicken meals, and even dog food (to restore health), ammo, and treasures, which solely exist for points. There are four weapons (knife, pistol, machine gun, and Gatling), all of them using the same bullets except the knife. The knife and the pistol are given at the start of the level, while the machine gun is either found (usually in secret areas) or picked up from SS troopers, and the Gatling is always dropped somewhere in the level.

418662.overview: It's Pong with lots of samples from the movie Wayne's World. It will drive you nuts. 419137.overview: Wild Flying never was finished. It is one of the more interesting attempts on the Amiga to make a texture-mapped 3D game. 420953.overview: A FPS style game demo based on Castle Wolfenstein.

420963.overview:
Wetten Dass..? is based on the German TV game show of the same name. The game can be played by up to four players. The player who gets most of the bets right earns the highest score and thus wins the game.

In practice mode, there is a variety of bets to choose from, for example identifying different doves. After being viewed both the pictures and the names of the doves, the player has 120 seconds to type in the names corresponding to the respective doves. Other bets include placing a car with a helicopter on four glasses without breaking them and docking a moving boat to a stamp on the dock wall.

In show mode, the bets are randomly selected and there's a show master commenting the progress of the game show candidates.

420977.overview: An unreleased horizontally scrolling shooter for one or two players.

421007.overview: Wizard Wars is a simple strategy game, you play a wizard in his tower who creates demons to send out to destroy the other wizards' towers.

The undulating landscape is made up of chunky voxels. The cars themselves and objects such as trees are 3D rendered bitmaps. Polygon objects making up the rest of the screen.

You have the option of running practice laps or taking part in the 15-course championship. Weather conditions are varied. Between rounds, you can tune up your car. You can save and resume your career to disk.

A text adventure game from Laura A. Knauth in 1999. The game got 1st place (out of 37) in the 5th Annual Interactive Fiction Competition that same year. Infocom-like game written with Inform with lots of good puzzles. It mostly takes place in a magical, positive winterland. Young Gretchen could have only imagined the fanciful events that were to occur before finding herself lost in a winter wonderland.

422404.overview: A simple pong game created jokingly by committee of the Activas Washing Corporation in 1990. Ah, the things we did before the internet arrived.

422405.overview:
A four player, shareware quiz\board game from Genetic EFX released in 1992. The object of the game is to be the first one to reach the end of the board. You move around the board by giving the correct answer to the clues given. When the game starts you will be asked for the number of players (up to 4), and which question bank to use. There is currently 4 banks each with 50 question cards. 

On your turn, click on one of the available numbered circles and the corresponding clue will be shown. You must then enter an answer before the timer runs out or click on the PASS icon. The timer automatically stops when you press a key (see Notes below). There is NO penalty for an incorrect answer or for PASSing. Some of the numbered circles contain BONUS moves which move the player forward, or PENALTY moves which move the player backward. Theses are shown in the clue box and also have an appropriate sound.

SCORING: The number of squares a player moves after giving a correct answer is equal to the number of clues remaining. For example, if you answer correctly on the 5th clue you will move 15 squares (20-5 = 15).

There are four categories Person, Place, thing or Year.

422407.overview: An addictive selection of word search games by Russell Mason and released as freeware in 1991.

422486.overview: An unfinished fighting game created in ASM 68k by Keith Bugeja and eventually released as PD, much later in 2019. It was an attempt to write a better version of Street Fighter 2 for the Amiga, later resurrected as an adult when interest was shown by the Amiga community.

422511.overview: An educational memory game released to schools and children programs as Licenceware in 1990. You are given 4 arrangements of a set of objects and must memorize the differences and be able see the differences to recreate them.

422572.overview:

The goal of the player is to move all the discs from the first peg to the last one in the same order by proper use of middle peg. The disks with a lower number can be placed on the disks with a higher number. The player has access to a disc which is currently at the highest level.

Depending on the selected level, the player will deal with 1 up to 9 discs. The game features single and two player mode, as well as demo introduction mode.

- Surround the German villages

422748.overview: Rolling Demo of a management strategy simulation based on controlling all the toilets.

As a prince of one of the district, the player must defeat the other rulers and unite the country. The gameplay is similar to Civilization, including cities development, diplomacy, trade or science. A 2 player checkers style board game from Prezemek Szelag released as part of the Polish made Zestaw Gier Logicznych 2 compilation pack. This game differs from the original checkers in that it does not have the so-called ladies. For bringing a plonk to the field on the opposite side, we receive one additional point (if we have already lost one).

422962.overview: A Worm\Snake shareware game from Proxima Software It's fun and you can play to 12 players simultaneous on 1 Amiga.

423019.overview: A collect\eat'm up known as Webz or Webs released as PD by Neil Sorenson in 1990. Avoid the scorpion and other spiders as you gobble up the delicious bugs and flies. Avoid the large enemies, the blend into the background locusts that hang around on the edges, the web firing spider and the little spiders and eat all the flies.

423033.overview: In this run and gun style shooter game, you play the titular White Knight as you battle hordes of baddies. The game was developed by Alex Sean using SEUCK.

423369.overview:

You can operate the program using Keyboard "Connand Keys", or using the Mouse to select and "Press" on-screen controls. To use a Command key you nust press the specified alphabetic key whilst at the sane tine holding down the (CTRL) key. You MUST remember to use (CTRL) with all Command Keys. Now press (CTRL) and (N) together to read the "Next page.Features mouse/keyboard control, the ability for end-users to create their own animated weather maps with scrolling messages, loading/saving of weather data, the ability for end-users to generate graphs and statistical tables to summarize weather data and a quit back to WB option.

423624.overview:
I just uploaded our texture mapping demo to aminet in gfx/misc. It should appear there in quite a few days.
* WELCOME TO WARP/S - TEXMAPP2 TEXTURE MAPPING ENGINE *

This engine is developed out of the old texmapp engine. Until now, there are quite many demos available. The first drew simple vector planes and just scaled the texture on it ( *shiver* :-). texmapp 1 was the first one with drawing a ground, bobbing up and down while walking and transparent textures.

Texmapp2 - which is now called WARP/S Engine - is completely different from texmapp1. First, we decided to use an AGA only Copper-Display, because that gave us different advantages and there is no chunky 2 planar conversion to do. The old engine was *completely* written in C (caused the slowness). The new one is now completely rewritten in assembler and all of the procedures were worked over.

We intended to do a game for CD32, so we optimized the engine for 020 and no fastmem. A sideeffect is that only one wall height is possible.

WARP/S now contains monsters, animations and doors as additional features.

WBArmy is a one or two player artillery game for playing in a window on the Workbench, inspired by Scorched Tanks. Two players, or one player and a computer-controlled enemy, control a pair of tanks in a jagged landscape. The goal is to destroy the opposing tank by entering the correct angle and power for the gun, taking into account gravity and wind. The tanks can also move, if they have enough fuel. Hitting the enemy gives cash awards, which can be used to replenish shields and fuel or to buy stronger projectiles. Bonuses are also dropped in the shape of air-drop crates in the landscape.

Environmental factors, colors and the computer's intelligence can be customized.

The game also has a follow-up in the shape of WinArmy.

You are presented with a menu about various aspects of the war. Choosing a subject moves you on to a screen with other topics, and you click on one to .see the next screen.

The text is presented in a simple text reader which anyone familiar with something like More or MuchMore will have no difficulty in using. Pictures and maps are displayed at (normally) full screen size, with a click of the mouse button returning you to the main screen.

481946.overview:
Wizard of Wor on Amiga: The Ultimate Port of the Commodore 64 Version (with Magic Voice Support)

When discussing classic arcade legends, Wizard of Wor holds a special place in the heart of every retrogamer. But which version is truly the best? Many tend to idolize the original arcade cabinet, which — upon closer aesthetic inspection — suffers from a bit of visual clutter: uneven colors, inconsistent backgrounds, and those background stars that, let's be honest, look rather unpleasant.

The Commodore 64 version, on the other hand, benefited from meticulous crafting and near-maniacal attention to detail. The limited palette forced an extraordinary graphic cleanliness, stripping away visual noise and leaving room for what truly matters: a clean background and pure, balanced, engaging gameplay.
